limitations: One board per chip, one AP and room-temperature conditions; no calibrated RF measurement or long-duration reliability claim.
Entire allocated transmit-gain PHY member replaced; ROM callbacks, initialization, RX/TX calibration and vendor state remain.
Original-instruction oracle compares ordered modeled boundary behavior; it does not prove cycle timing, RF or analog equivalence.
Packet gaps and latency tails remain open; this comparison records actual counts without claiming a fix.
AP Ethernet captures corroborate EAPOL exchanges but are not complete independent RF captures.

timing_observations.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

iram_placement.limits: S3 Bluetooth callback targets retain their original runtime behavior. Entry/literal placement is not transitive flash-independence proof.

validation_tool_corrections: Native interpreter supports compiler-generated ROM memset and proven terminal bounds-panic sites; no tested valid case reaches panic.
Only the unused twelfth argument at internal wifi_get boundaries is masked; LLVM can omit its outgoing stack slot. Every consumed argument and effect is compared.
Joint cases exposed unchecked multiplication in synthetic host callback output generation; the host mock now uses explicit wrapping.
No production firmware semantic correction was needed during host/native comparison.
